{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the treatment arm is correctly identified and calculate fraction of responders
# Only patients in the 'treatment' arm are considered
treatment_arm = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Ensure the 'responded' column is binary (0 or 1) and no missing values
assert treatment_arm['responded'].isin([0, 1]).all(), "'responded' column contains non-binary values"
assert not treatment_arm['responded'].isnull().any(), "'responded' column has missing values"

# Calculate the fraction of responders in the treatment arm
treatment_responders = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()
total_treatment = len(treatment_arm)
fraction_responders = treatment_responders / total_treatment

# Print the result
fraction_responders"}
